record.original_question: Is the map H∗ (BPL(M )δ ; Fp ) → H∗ (BPL(M ); Fp ) an isomorphism in all degrees?

evidence.quote: Question 9.10. Is the map H∗ (BPL(M )δ ; Fp ) → H∗ (BPL(M ); Fp ) an isomorphism in all degrees?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a closed piecewise linear (PL) manifold, and let $\mathrm{PL}(M)$ denote the topological group of PL self-homeomorphisms of $M$ equipped with its natural (e.g. compact-open / simplicial) topology. Let $\mathrm{PL}(M)^\delta$ denote the same group equipped with the discrete topology. Write $B\mathrm{PL}(M)$ and $B\mathrm{PL}(M)^\delta$ for their classifying spaces, and let $\iota \colon B\mathrm{PL}(M)^\delta \to B\mathrm{PL}(M)$ be the natural map induced by the identity homomorphism $\mathrm{PL}(M)^\delta \to \mathrm{PL}(M)$. Fix a prime $p$.

Question: Is the induced map on mod-$p$ singular homology
$$\iota_* \colon H_*(B\mathrm{PL}(M)^\delta;\mathbb{F}_p) \longrightarrow H_*(B\mathrm{PL}(M);\mathbb{F}_p)$$
an isomorphism in every degree?

(This is a Friedlander–Milnor–type conjecture for the group of PL self-homeomorphisms of a manifold.)
artifact.category_tag: Friedlander–Milnor conjecture for PL homeomorphism groups
artifact.status_search_result: The question is a Friedlander–Milnor-type conjecture, asking whether the natural map from the classifying space of PL(M) with the discrete topology to the classifying space of PL(M) with its natural topology induces an isomorphism on mod-p homology. The classical Friedlander–Milnor conjecture (for Lie groups) and its variants for diffeomorphism/homeomorphism groups remain open in general; no evidence was found that this PL-version has been resolved. It is therefore listed as an open question.

status_evidence.title: On the cohomology of classifying spaces of groups of homeomorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Studies cohomology of classifying spaces of homeomorphism groups, related to Friedlander–Milnor type questions which remain open.
status_evidence.claim: Friedlander–Milnor type comparison maps between classifying spaces with discrete and natural topologies are studied but remain unresolved in general.
